title: AI stock research has become part of my routine
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/39bbmkegsarh1.jpg?width=1080&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=83d037f5805711a68c274ae42e725fde44aada8b

A few months ago, if a stock suddenly jumped 10–15% i'd spend half an hour digging through news articles, earnings reports,  analyst notes, and whatever people were saying online.

Now i usually do something more simple: i've been using [Tickeron's](https://tickeron.com/) AI article feature to generate a quick report on  whatever i'm looking at. If a stock is making a big move  i hit "Why price moved today?" and get a detailed breakdown of what's driving it.

The surprising part isn't that the AI magically finds secret information, it just puts everything together fast enough that I can decide whether the story is worth investigating further.

This week i noticed a stock making  a strong move early in the session. generated the article, read through the catalysts, checked a few things myself, and opened a position. The move continued through the day and ended up being one of my better trades all week.

I've also been using the earnings articles quite a bit, reading a recap is a lot easier than digging through a release and transcript when im following multiple names.

Curious if anyone else is using AI to research like this or if most people still prefer doing everything manually
